text:
Priya (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: several teams asked for clearer GA criteria and a single canonical timeline for API v2, Console GA, and Optimize cost suggestions. can leadership confirm?

Sam (CTO): short version: we can publish conservative targets this week and a live status widget that shows canary health. targets are not contracts.

Jules (Eng): engineering note on API v2: surface is stable, remaining work is perf tuning and two security reviews. plan: 10-day canary, 7-day ramp, GA if no P1s. timeline target: canary early Aug, GA by late Sep.

Lena (Platform): Console GA depends on the migration tooling for dedicated customers and dashboard RBAC. proposed staging cadence: internal dogfood in Aug, invited beta Sept, GA Oct. Ops needs a rollback-tested migration path and a migration DR plan.

Chris (DevRel): partners asked for a feature matrix (beta vs GA) and sample scripts. can product publish a short matrix and a migration cheat sheet?

Priya (Product): yes 12: I'll produce a 1-page matrix + cheat sheet. draft targets below (provisional):

``
- API v2: canary ~ 2026-08-07, GA target ~ 2026-09-25
- Console: invited beta ~ 2026-09-10, GA target ~ 2026-10-12
- Optimize (cost-suggestions): opt-in preview ~ 2026-09-02, public beta ~ 2026-09-22
``

Jules (Eng): proposing acceptance criteria for API v2: security reviews passed, canary P99 within 1.2x baseline, no memory leaks after 72h soak, and infra metrics within expected ranges.

Lena (Platform): Console acceptance: migration dry-run success on 3 tenants, RBAC tests green, and a 30-minute migration runbook validated. ops will require 48h of post-migration monitoring before sign-off.

Chris (DevRel): partner comms needs: feature flag names, SDK changes, and example migration logs. I'll collect partner questions and add to the FAQ.

Priya (Product): action list: 1) Priya -> publish matrix + status widget; 2) Jules -> post perf/security checklist; 3) Lena -> schedule dry-runs + publish migration runbook; 4) Chris -> partner FAQ draft. I'll post links in this thread by Wednesday EOD.

ops-bot: notice: canary-reserve scheduled 2026-08-04 07:00 UTC.

Sam (CTO): decision note: share targets with wording "target dates — subject to canary and migration runbook sign-off". we'll provide a canary update 10 days after canary start. keep updates to this thread for partner-facing clarity.

Priya (Product): thanks all. short updates only here please. :white_check_mark:
